candidate_relations.reason: Gingival cysts arise from rests of dental lamina in the gingival soft tissue and do not correspond to the intraosseous, gelatinous/fatty lesion described or to the reference diagnosis of intraosseous lipoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Gingival cyst is a soft-tissue cyst of the gingiva, not an intraosseous lipoma

candidate_relations.reason: Dentigerous cysts are fluid-filled odontogenic cysts surrounding impacted tooth crowns; they do not produce gelatinous/mushy fatty tissue and are a different diagnostic entity from intraosseous lipoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Dentigerous cyst is an odontogenic cyst associated with the crown of an unerupted tooth, not an intraosseous lipoma

candidate_relations.reason: Giant cell granuloma is composed of multinucleated giant cells in a fibrovascular stroma; it does not match the gelatinous, fatty tissue characteristic of intraosseous lipoma and is a distinct diagnostic entity.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Giant Cell Granuloma is a reactive/neoplastic lesion of giant cells, not an intraosseous lipoma
